  • Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups

jobDescription:
Overview
The Test Manager - AI is responsible for leading the organisations quality engineering and AI testing strategy, driving the adoption of innovative testing practices, intelligent automation, and AI-enabled quality solutions across the technology landscape. Operating within a complex enterprise environment, the role provides testing leadership across multiple programs, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, reliable, scalable, and secure solutions that align with business objectives.
This role is accountable for shaping and advancing next-generation quality engineering capabilities by integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) into the testing lifecycle. The Test Manager - AI will champion the transformation of traditional testing approaches through the implementation of intelligent, predictive, and self-optimising testing frameworks that enhance efficiency, quality, and delivery outcomes.
Leading global testing teams and collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders, the role fosters a culture of quality, innovation, and continuous improvement while driving testing maturity, operational excellence, and the adoption of industry-leading practices across the organisation.

Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities
Strategic Focus
  • Formulate the strategic vision and technical roadmap for integrating AI and Generative AI into the testing lifecycle. Oversee the deployment of intelligent frameworks optimizing automated test case generation, autonomous test execution, and computer-vision visual validations.
  • Manage and accountable for a Portfolio of programs/projects to ensure successful delivery and taking Business on the quality journey.
  • Strong due diligence and analysis skills towards test solution designing.
  • Oversee the modernization of scalable enterprise test automation frameworks embedded seamlessly into high-velocity CI/CD continuous delivery pipelines.
  • Deploy AI/ML analytical tools to evaluate historical defect logs, identifying risk patterns, predicting system regressions, and proactively adjusting test focus areas.
  • Formulate an effective, practical but robust Test Strategy by coordinating with all relevant stakeholders considering a highly complex financial services environment.
  • Assess any quality gaps and keep the stakeholders informed in timely manner and suggest solution to resolve any blockers.
  • Identify areas of improvement and establish a continuous improvement process.
Operational Management
  • Manage the Full E2E testing lifecycle of assigned projects in a multi-vendor and in distributed delivery environment.
  • Evaluate, proof-of-concept, and manage commercial relationships with emerging AI testing vendors, maximizing ROI across tools, frameworks, and resource allocations.
  • Review program/project level business requirements, technical specifications, end to end Business Processes and solution design documents, highlighting any gaps or potential improvements.
  • Define and deploy defect preventive process and measures in distributed delivery model.
  • Defect Management activities (prioritization, including, conducting defect triage meeting with business, technology & interface partners); work with relevant stakeholders to agree on workaround for outstanding defects and defects resolutions.
  • Participate in the planning of UAT, PVT for Programs and Projects (including approach and scope of PVT).
  • Facilitates the development, implementation, and adherence of testing department standards in partnership with other test team leaders.
  • Establish key performance indicators and quality metrics to measure and report on the effectiveness of the testing process.
  • Communicate quality metrics to relevant stakeholders.
  • Review reports produced by the testing teams, provide guidance, evolve process, and actively participate in resolving issues/roadblocks to testing progress.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance AI testing frameworks, processes, and automation capabilities.
  • Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to project teams on AI testing methodologies, Responsible AI validation, test automation approaches, and emerging industry practices.
  • Mentor the testing team and contribute to building AI testing capabilities across teams through coaching, standards adoption, and continuous learning initiatives.
People Leadership
  • Support the project team in leveraging testing tools to improve team productivity and effectiveness (Test Management, Defect Management, and Test Automation, Performance Testing, AI Driven Testing).
  • Work within a team contributing to:
  • Timely delivery of assigned tasks and project outcomes.
  • Effective use of technology to solve business challenges and improve operational efficiency.
  • Innovation and continuous improvement through the development of practical and scalable solutions.
  • Motivate the team to consistently deliver quality results through collaboration, accountability, and innovation.
Governance & Risk
  • Review and sign-off of testing artefacts (Test Plans and Test Summary Reports), liaising with respective project team members (including Development teams, Test teams, Business, Solution Designers, Architects, IT, PMs, and other stakeholders.)
  • Governance and management of vendor achievement against Service Level Agreements, measuring performance against established metrics and evaluating third-party operations for quality and adherence to agreed schedule and budget requirements to align delivered Services with business IT needs and key stakeholder expectations.
  • Manage and document the quality assurance activities with internal reporting and audits.
  • Validate adherence to Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and governance standards.
  • Conduct and support the assessment and reporting of AI-related risks, including model bias, explainability, fairness, and data quality concerns.
  • Ensure maintenance of appropriate test evidence, validation reports, defect records, and audit documentation to support governance and compliance requirements.
  • Escalate risks, issues, and control gaps that may impact AI solution quality, regulatory compliance, or business outcomes.
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

Experience & Personal Attributes
Experience
  • Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline
  • 14+ years of authentic experience in Software Testing, Quality Assurance, and Engineering.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in direct managerial or organizational leadership capacities, directly managing distributed engineering teams in complex E2E integrated financial platform.
  • Practical experience utilizing Generative AI models (e.g., OpenAI API, GitHub Copilot) for building intelligent synthetic data, structural test scaffolding, and automating framework maintenance.
  • Knowledge or functional experience in testing and handling validation patterns specific to AI/ML software ecosystems.
  • Extensive experience in managing a multi-vendor engagement.
  • Extensive experience in building process, practices, and test team in distributed delivery model
  • Strong E2E test management background within a fast-paced business and in complex IT application landscape.
  • Strong commercial / business acumen
  • Experience in CI/CD pipeline and tools such as Azure Devops
  • Accounting / Superannuation / Insurance / BFSI highly desirable.
  • Core automation experience in Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium.
  • Experience in API testing, Mobile, App testing highly desirable.
  • Certification in Domain/Testing/Delivery methodology like ISTQB, Agile, ASFA highly desirable
  • Working experience working in an Agile scrum environment, expert in JIRA and Confluence or similar tools
  • Hands on experience in improving Testing & QA capabilities with a strong awareness of industry developments and best practice.
  • Managing the mobilization and operation of Testing services.
  • A strong background in financial services & pensions industry will be highly advantageous.
Personal Attributes
  • Demonstrate strong thought leadership, strategic thinking, and effective communication in driving and uplifting Quality through all stages of the SDLC - and within the Test practice.
  • Strong influential skills with an emphasis on building quality output, and continuous improvement
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, needed to communicate with global teams/stakeholders.
  • Practical and simple problem-solving approach.
  • Capable of managing high pressure and short timelines, with the willingness to be flexible
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously and prioritize them

ROLE PURPOSE
Serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for architecting, designing, and delivering enterprise-scale, cloud-native Java solutions while raising engineering standards through deep technical expertise, hands-on problem solving, and architecture influence.
DESIGNATION - Principal Software Engineer

EXPERIENCE - 12+ years

LOCATION - Hyderabad, India

FUNCTION
Software Engineering DOMAIN Enterprise / Healthcare WORK MODEL As applicable

We are seeking an accomplished Principal Software Engineer to operate as a senior individual contributor focused on technical strategy, solution architecture, hands-on engineering, and modernization of enterprise platforms. This role is not a people-management position; it is designed for a deeply technical leader who can influence architecture, guide engineering direction, solve complex technical problems, and deliver high-quality solutions through expertise and credibility.

The successful candidate will bring strong experience across Java, Spring, Azure, DevOps, Kafka, Spark, APIs, relational databases, distributed systems, resiliency, security, and performance engineering. This individual will partner with architects, product owners, engineering teams, QA, and production support to translate complex requirements into scalable designs, reference implementations, technical patterns, and production-ready software.

Primary Responsibilities:
  • Architecture and Technical Design
    • Own and influence architecture for complex enterprise applications, services, APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and cloud-native components
    • Translate business and platform requirements into scalable solution designs, architecture decisions, technical specifications, and implementation-ready engineering guidance
    • Define and promote reusable technical patterns, reference implementations, design guardrails, and engineering standards across teams
    • Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, resilience, performance, observability, maintainability, and operational support expectations
  • Hands-on Engineering and Technical Execution
    • Design, build, test, debug, optimize, and document complex enterprise applications, microservices, APIs, Spark jobs, and integration components
    • Provide hands-on expertise in Java, Spring, Azure, DevOps, Kafka, distributed systems, data processing, and application architecture patterns
    • Solve complex technical problems independently, including performance bottlenecks, scalability constraints, deployment issues, defect root causes, and production-readiness gaps
    • Build reliable Kafka producer and consumer integrations, support event-driven architecture patterns, and guide teams on operationally safe implementation practices
    • Deliver high-quality engineering outcomes without direct people-management responsibility, using technical influence, mentoring, and design authority to raise team capability
  • AI-Enabled Engineering and Modernization
    • Apply AI-assisted development practices to accelerate design analysis, coding, unit testing, documentation, defect analysis, modernization, and engineering productivity
    • Use tools such as Codex, Claude, and comparable AI engineering assistants responsibly, with strong validation of generated code, test cases, designs, and documentation
    • Identify high-value modernization opportunities where AI can reduce manual effort, improve engineering quality, and accelerate transformation of legacy applications and data-processing workloads
    • Promote secure, compliant, and measurable use of AI tools while ensuring outputs meet enterprise engineering standards
  • Testing, Quality, and Release Readiness
    • Prepare test plans, define test data requirements, establish test environments, and execute testing activities based on project needs
    • Participate in design reviews, test case reviews, and Production Support readiness reviews for new releases
    • Support QA, UAT, release, and post-release phases through defect analysis, root cause identification, change maintenance, and issue resolution
    • Promote test automation and ensure adherence to coding standards, documentation standards, quality controls, and delivery governance
    • Confirm that solutions meet functional, technical, performance, supportability, and timeline requirements before release
  • Technical Influence and Cross-Team Collaboration
    • Partner with architects, product owners, SMEs, development teams, QA, DevOps, and production support to align technical decisions with business outcomes and platform strategy
    • Lead architecture and design reviews, provide constructive technical feedback, and help teams make informed trade-off decisions
    • Create and maintain architecture decisions, technical design documents, integration specifications, operational runbooks, test evidence, and release-support artifacts
    • Communicate complex technical topics clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including risks, options, dependencies, and recommendations
  • Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so
Required Qualifications:
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including deep hands-on experience building and architecting large-scale enterprise applications
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka streams, event-driven architecture, and reliable producer and consumer implementations
  • Experience defining architecture, technical designs, integration patterns, resiliency approaches, performance strategies, and production-readiness standards
  • Experience designing, developing, testing, debugging, documenting, and optimizing complex Spark jobs or large-scale data-processing workloads
  • Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, or comparable relational database platforms, including SQL development, data modeling awareness, and performance considerations
  • Solid expertise in Java, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, Azure Cloud, DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices
  • Proven ability to operate independently as a senior individual contributor while influencing technical direction across teams
  • Proven solid communication skills with the ability to explain architecture decisions, engineering risks, and solution trade-offs clearly
  • AI and Modern Engineering Capabilities
    • Knowledge of AI Builder and AI-enabled development workflows
    • Proficiency with Codex, Claude, or comparable AI-assisted engineering tools
    • Ability to coach developers on safe, effective, and outcome-oriented use of AI tools and credits
    • Ability to validate AI-generated code and documentation for security, correctness, maintainability, compliance, and alignment with engineering standards

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience in Pharmacy Benefit Management, healthcare, insurance, or other highly regulated enterprise domains
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery models across geographically distributed teams
  • Exposure to production-critical batch processing, high-volume data pipelines, and enterprise integration platforms
  • Knowledge of AS/400 or IBM i platforms and legacy application modernization

Individual Contributor Competencies
  • Architecture ownership
    • Owns complex design decisions and connects technical direction to platform outcomes
  • Technical influence
    • Builds alignment through expertise, design clarity, mentoring, and trusted engineering judgment
  • Engineering excellence
    • Raises quality, security, resilience, observability, automation, and maintainability standards
  • Deep technical problem solving
    • Resolves complex engineering issues through analysis, experimentation, and pragmatic execution
  • Ownership and accountability
    • Operates independently, drives outcomes, and proactively identifies risks and dependencies
  • Modern engineering mindset
    • Applies AI, automation, cloud, and modernization practices to improve delivery outcomes

Measures of Success
  • Architecture and design decisions improve scalability, resilience, security, performance, maintainability, and operational supportability
  • Complex engineering problems are resolved with strong root-cause analysis, practical execution, and minimal production impact
  • Reference implementations, engineering standards, and technical patterns improve consistency and delivery quality across teams
  • AI-assisted engineering and automation produce measurable improvements in productivity, quality, documentation, and modernization velocity
  • Stakeholders have clear visibility into architecture decisions, technical risks, dependencies, and recommended solution paths

AI Orchestration: High Level Understanding of LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI - agentic workflow design, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, human-in-the-loop workflows
Observability: Metrics, logging, and distributed tracing at scale - SLO engineering, alerting design, and incident response tooling

LLM AI Tooling: High Level understanding of OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini - prompt engineering, RAG architecture, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB), LLMOps
Incident Management: Production incident ownership, structured RCA, and reliability engineering practices in high-availability FSI environments
Cost Engineering: FinOps practices - reserved instance/committed use optimisation, tagging strategy, and cost allocation across AWS and GCP estates

- Experience with service mesh (Istio or Linkerd) for microservices networking and observability
- Familiarity with data platform engineering - Kafka, Spark, or cloud-native analytics services on AWS or GCP
